Title: Azure NetApp Files Resource GUID change

Body.Content:
Effective July 1, 2019, the resource GUIDs (also known as meter IDs) for Azure NetApp Files will change due to a change in the unit of measure. The following resource GUIDs will have a unit of measure change from GB to GiB. You will need to modify billing routines before July 1, 2019 that rely on the resource GUID and names.
